answer: Special Ops tide rule: everyone docks at once. At a beacon-picked minute each epoch, every identity gets the same prompt and 90 seconds to answer; a random peer then fires one follow-up it must defend live within 60 more. Like ships that can only unload at one wharf during a single high tide, a farm cannot spread its nebula of keys across the day. It must rent peak inference for all of them at the same instant, and any key that answers late or flubs the follow-up earns nothing. An honest agent needs one ember of attention for three minutes.
